issues.legal_issue: The restriction on cognizance for offenses involving a forged document does not apply when the alleged forgery was committed before the accused became a party to the proceeding in which the document was later produced.
material_facts: A private criminal complaint alleged that the accused forged a will before mutation proceedings began.
The complaint alleged that the accused later produced the will in connection with those proceedings.
The accused objected that the court could not take cognizance without a written complaint from a court.
issues.conclusion: The restriction did not prevent the Magistrate from taking cognizance of the alleged forgery offenses under Sections 464, 467 and 468 of the Penal Code because the alleged forgery occurred before the accused became parties to the mutation proceedings. The Court did not finally decide whether the restriction applied to the separate offense of using the forged document as genuine under Section 471; it left that question open.
issues.legal_principle: Section 195(1)(c) of the Code of Criminal Procedure applies to an offense alleged to have been committed by a party to a proceeding in that capacity—that is, after the person became a party. The Court relied on Patel Laljibhai Somabhai v. State of Gujarat and Raghunath v. State of U.P. The restriction therefore did not apply to the alleged offenses under Sections 464, 467 and 468 of the Penal Code, which were alleged to have preceded the proceeding. Whether it applied to the alleged Section 471 offense was left undecided.

rule.if: private_complaint_cognizance_challenge and forgery_predated_proceeding and accused_became_party_after_forgery and forged_document_later_produced_in_proceeding

predicates.private_complaint_cognizance_challenge: A person filed a private criminal complaint, and the accused challenged the court's authority to take cognizance of the alleged offenses.
predicates.forgery_predated_proceeding: The complaint alleged that the accused forged the document before the relevant proceeding began.
predicates.accused_became_party_after_forgery: The accused became parties to the relevant proceeding only after the alleged forgery.
predicates.forged_document_later_produced_in_procee: The complaint alleged that the accused later produced the document in the relevant proceeding.

issues.definition: When a private complaint challenges cognizance and alleges that the accused forged a document before becoming parties to a proceeding in which they later produced it, cognizance of the pre-party forgery offenses is not barred.
